author: kedhareswer
description: A calm, minimal personal website: floating pill nav with command palette and light/dark toggle, intro, work history, essays with a reading progress line and recent work. React, one file, no dependencies. Install the code: npx shadcn@latest add https://21st.dev/r/kedhareswer/quiet-portfolio-template
